verdict.rationale: Rippling's API supports searching, filtering, and paginating large sets of records (docs-16,17) and its automation engine applies rules/policies across many users and devices at once (docs-3,6,18), which functions as a form of bulk operation, but there is no explicit documentation of a bulk create/update/delete API action or UI bulk-select feature. missing for 10: explicit bulk-write/batch endpoint documentation, UI evidence of multi-select bulk actions, independent confirmation of bulk operation scale/performance.
